notes.title: We've Been Nominated!
notes.content:
CROWDED. FOLLOWED. has been nominated for the Technical Achievement Award as part of The Horror Game Awards! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053896/5647895e5e216c827ae9754f0e0563a8e6d8d204.jpg
 We are so chuffed to have been nominated!
There are 3 days left, so please consider giving us your vote at: thehorrorgameawards.com/vote/


Thank you!!
